source_summary: Vertical ink Chinese landscape with layered mountains and mist above, bamboo and bare winter trees in the middle ground, a small rocky stream, and a large gnarled foreground tree-and-bamboo cluster. Calligraphy, seals, border, and paper texture are excluded from motifs.

motifs.name: right_towering_mountain
motifs.description: Isolate the large steep mountain mass on the upper right, including the rounded summit, dark craggy ridges, descending slopes, and mist-softened lower edges, without the nearby bare trees or calligraphy area.
must_preserve: layered hemp-fiber contour strokes following the mountain curvature
dark ink accents along ridge creases and summit edges
dry-brush rock texture and stippled shadow masses
soft wash transitions where the slope dissolves into mist

motifs.name: left_mist_hills_and_peaks
motifs.description: Isolate the low misty ridge system on the upper left and center, including small dark peaks, pale rounded hills, and the atmospheric gap before the main mountain.
must_preserve: faint rounded hill outlines
small dark triangular peak accents
light broken texture strokes on ridge faces
misty blank-paper separations between hill layers

motifs.name: midground_bamboo_thicket
motifs.description: Isolate the horizontal bamboo thicket across the middle-left slope, with clustered stalks and dense pointed leaves sitting on a pale bank.
must_preserve: individual bamboo leaf clusters in sharp dark ink
thin angled stalk lines
irregular shrub silhouette along the bank
light ground wash beneath the thicket

motifs.name: right_bare_tree_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the group of tall leafless trees at the middle-right foot of the mountain, including slim trunks, fine branching crowns, and the dark shrub mass at the far right base.
must_preserve: thin bare branch linework
vertical trunks with varied ink weight
dark dotted foliage or shrub texture at lower right
pale mist gaps around trunks

motifs.name: arched_bare_tree_bank
motifs.description: Isolate the small arched bare tree or fallen trunk form crossing the middle bank, with its curved main limb, thin upward branchlets, and dark clustered brush at the base.
must_preserve: arched sweeping trunk line
fine twig-like branch extensions
dark dry-brush knots at the base
subtle bank contour lines around the roots

motifs.name: rocky_stream_cascade
motifs.description: Isolate the narrow stream and cascade on the right-middle, including curved water channels, small stones, dark banks, and the flowing bend emerging from the hillside.
must_preserve: parallel curved water lines
small rounded pebble shapes
dark ink bank edges
short wash strokes indicating sloped ground and water movement

motifs.name: midground_rock_outcrop
motifs.description: Isolate the compact rocky outcrop in the open middle area, with dark shrubs on top and several rounded boulders attached to its right side.
must_preserve: craggy rock outline
dark stippled shrub texture on the crown
rounded boulder forms to the right
dry-brush interior rock texture and shadow pockets

motifs.name: foreground_gnarled_tree_bamboo_cluster
motifs.description: Isolate the large foreground cluster of gnarled trunks, bare branches, bamboo sprays, and low grasses rooted on the lower bank, excluding seals and border areas.
must_preserve: twisting heavy trunks with dark root bases
fine bare branch networks reaching left and right
bamboo leaf sprays in dense pointed clusters
dry-brush bark texture, moss-like dots, and pale grass strokes on the surrounding bank

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
